about: The login screen at the first boot (docs/adr/0020-oxy-account-login.mdx, step 2): no account is enrolled, so it opens on adding one; offline (Oxy's API is a refused port), setup says it needs the network and does nothing else: no account, no password field, nobody signed in, and no way back to an empty list. Reintentar looks again, offline still.

steps.name: Reintentar: still offline, and nothing else is offered
